task: ae.suffix suffix-array toolkit: prefix-doubling SA, Kasai LCP, SuffixIndex search/repeats/kth/LCSubstring, BWT, sampled FM-index
reasoning_summary: Wrote tests first with naive oracles (sorted suffixes, indexOf, TreeSet of substrings, brute-force longest common substring). Built prefix-doubling SA, Kasai LCP and layered SuffixIndex, BWT and FM-index on it. All 30 tests passed on the first run; kill-checks of four mutants found one survivor (Kasai reset) which a periodic-input time-bound test now kills.
